priorityList: Use damage-increasing trinkets, potions, and racial abilities on cooldown, ideally during burst windows.
Cast Flurry if Brain Freeze is active, unless Thermal Void is currently active.
Cast Frozen Orb on cooldown to generate Fingers of Frost and Icicles.
Cast Glacial Spike as soon as you have 5 Icicles.
Cast Ice Lance if you have Fingers of Frost active.
Cast Ice Lance if the target has 10 or more stacks of the Freezing debuff.
Cast Flurry whenever it is available to generate Winter's Chill.
Cast Ray of Frost on cooldown, especially if Frostfire Empowerment is not active.
Cast Frostbolt as your primary filler spell to generate procs and Icicles.
Use Blink or Shimmer to maintain casting uptime during movement.
If forced to move and no procs are available, use Ice Lance as a filler.
